caption: The drawing depicts a single cream-colored skirt that appears to be made of a light, delicate fabric. The skirt is shown front-on, and it flares gently outward from a gathered waistband at the top. Along the bottom edge, there is a decorative embroidered border with floral and geometric motifs in various pastel colors including pink, green, blue, yellow, and a touch of red. The embroidery pattern features small flowers, stylized leaves, and arrangements of colorful threadwork arranged in a horizontal band. The bottom hem of the skirt is finished with a scalloped lace trim that is pale in color and has a fine, netted appearance. The background of the composition is plain and beige, and the artist’s name “FRITZ BOEHM” is visible in small print near the lower right corner of the sheet.
title: Zoar Embroidered Flannel Petticoat
